scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w apps/web" "cd apps/api && uv run python -m uvicorn convertbox_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"

scripts.test:load:extended: cd apps/api && uv run --extra test python ../../tests/load/extended.py
